deviations.description: Admit fixture (Case 45) must land the extension manifest end-to-end in the actual git commit.
deviations.reason: Plan's Non-Goals forbade touching git-commit-scoped.sh's V10 containment guard (Site 3), on the premise a Site-2-only splice would suffice. Testing proved this false: Site 2 admitting the manifest path into kept_files_touched/stage_paths just hands it to git-commit-scoped.sh as a positive pathspec, which Site 3's own unwidened V10 guard then drops anyway, tripping the post-commit completeness check (exit 6) -- a regression versus the pre-existing silent drop. Fixed by mirroring the identical pure-string derivation into git-commit-scoped.sh's own containment_scope_arr resolution, matching how the three pre-existing splices are already mirrored at both sites. Non-vacuous pinning re-verified for BOTH splices by temporarily disabling each in turn and confirming Case 45/48 fail, then restoring (git diff --stat empty afterward, confirming byte-identical restoration).
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- Site-3 mirror added to git-commit-scoped.sh, not in original plan scope)*
